task: ФОРМАТ ВИДЕО ПОДТВЕРЖДЁН ЮЗЕРОМ: ПЛАВНОЕ видео (не 1fps-слайды). Записывать поток камеры ~реалтайм 10с → mp4 (sendVideo в TG + архив runs/incidents/<event_id>.mp4). VLM-анализ отдельно по 1 кадру/сек. Если YOLO-пайплайн даёт мало fps для плавности — отдельный capture для видео. Заложи в PLAN.
goal: To implement a robust system for capturing 10 seconds of smooth, real-time camera video, saving it as MP4, sending it to Telegram, archiving it, and performing VLM analysis at 1 frame/second, potentially using a separate capture stream if other processing pipelines (like YOLO) impact video smoothness.
constraints: Video must be sent via `sendVideo` to Telegram.
VLM analysis must be performed at 1 frame/second.
If the YOLO pipeline causes low FPS for smoothness, a separate video capture stream must be used.
known_context: The video format requirements are user-confirmed.
A YOLO pipeline exists and might interfere with video capture FPS.
Telegram integration with `sendVideo` capability is available.
output_format: A detailed plan or architectural description for implementing the video capture and processing pipeline.
success_tests: An MP4 file is successfully created at `runs/incidents/<event_id>.mp4`.
The archived MP4 video is approximately 10 seconds long.
The archived MP4 video exhibits smooth playback (e.g., frame rate >= 25 FPS).
A video message is successfully sent to Telegram using `sendVideo` with the captured MP4.
VLM analysis results are available, indicating processing at a rate of 1 frame per second from the video stream.
If a YOLO pipeline was active during capture, and it impacted FPS, a separate capture mechanism was correctly employed to ensure video smoothness.
